channel.title: Marketing & Sales Software — new honest reviews
channel.description: Hand-researched software reviews: real pricing, the catch and who should skip it.

item.title: ShopTrueProfit Review (2026): Profit Reports for Etsy Sellers
item.description: ShopTrueProfit: Free costs $0 and gives a full sample-data demo, your latest month, the Etsy, eBay and Amazon fee calculators.

item.title: MailVeri Review (2026): Bulk Email Verification, Pay as You Go
item.description: MailVeri sells pay-as-you-go credit packs with no subscription. The accuracy and savings figures come from MailVeri’s own pricing page and comparison tables.

item.title: Cloze CRM Review (2026): Email-First CRM for Small Teams
item.description: Cloze CRM: Cloze has four paid plans and a 14 day free trial with no credit card. The pricing page does not name the currency and shows no free plan limits.

item.title: AddressHero Review (2026): Address Checks for Shopify Stores
item.description: AddressHero sells three plans for Shopify stores, each with a 14-day free trial. Lite does not validate against address databases or correct automatically.

item.title: Ship.com Review (2026): Discounted Shipping Labels for Sellers
item.description: Ship.com: Growth costs $19.99 a month, or $14 a month on the yearly toggle. Postage is billed on top of every plan, the page shows no postage rates.

item.title: LinkShortener.io Review (2026): Branded Short Links and QR Codes
item.description: LinkShortener.io: Free costs $0 for 20 a month on the shared tli.sh domain and needs an account but no card.

item.title: eReleases Review (2026): Press Release Distribution Service
item.description: eReleases: Buzz Builder costs $399 and covers 400 words and 1 industry target list. Add-ons cost $150 or more each, the page shows no refund terms.

item.title: RankSlide Review (2026): Search Console Drop Alerts, $48 a Year
item.description: RankSlide: Pro covers 5 sites for $106 a year, shown as $8.83 a month. The page text shows no refund or cancellation terms.

item.title: P2COS Review (2026): Local-First Prospecting and CRM Desktop App
item.description: P2COS: Annual standard prices are $199.99, $399.99 and $699.99. The software needs a paid licence, and several support features are listed as coming soon.

item.title: Kedra AI Index Review (2026): AI Visibility for Shopify Stores
item.description: Kedra AI Index: Kedra has a Free plan and three paid plans. It works only on Shopify, and the visibility results come from the vendor's own tests.

item.title: PinBee Review (2026): Pinterest Analytics Browser Extension
item.description: PinBee has a free plan with no time limit and no account. It works on desktop browsers only, and the free plan scans four pages per search.

item.title: LocalTry Review (2026): CRM With a Built-In AI Command Layer
item.description: LocalTry: Core is $59 a month for 2 users and 1 workspace, Operator is $99 a month for 5 users and 15 workspaces. A card is needed even for the 3-day trial.

item.title: IndieMade Review (2026): Independent Store Builder with Etsy Sync
item.description: IndieMade lists two plans, Essential and Plus. The pricing page no longer shows plan prices, so you only see the cost at signup.

item.title: Adwave Review (2026): Prepaid Wallet Ads for Phone, TV and Search
item.description: Adwave: A top-up can be any amount from $30 to $50,000, with presets of $100, $250 and $1,000. Most of the product sits behind an account.

item.title: Tradelle Review (2026): Dropshipping Research, From $19.99/mo
item.description: Tradelle: Lite is $29.99 a month, or $19.99 a month billed as $239.88 a year. The subscription is only the start of the bill.

item.title: RankBolt Review (Tested): AI SEO Articles and Rank Tracking
item.description: RankBolt prices in Swiss francs and sells three monthly plans, each with a 3-day free trial that, per the page, needs no credit card.

item.title: SocialDesk Review (2026): AI Social Scheduler, From $19/mo
item.description: SocialDesk sells four monthly plans and every one starts with a 7-day free trial that, per the page, needs no credit card. Pinterest is not supported yet.

item.title: Mystrika Review (2026): Cold Email, Free Plan, From $16/mo
item.description: Mystrika: Free Forever costs $0, needs no card and gives 500 prospect slots, up to 50 senders.

item.title: HighLevel Review (2026): Agency CRM & Automation From $97/mo
item.description: HighLevel: Starter costs $97 a month ($970 a year) and is meant for one business or a few clients. The headline plan price is only part of the bill.

item.title: Elite Site Optimizer Review (2026): SEO Tools From $49/mo
item.description: Elite Site Optimizer: Basic costs $49 a month ($470 a year) for 1 domain, 1 user, 1 campaign, 100 keywords, 1,000 crawl pages and 3 competitors.

item.title: DataHawk Review (2026): Amazon Analytics, Custom Pricing
item.description: DataHawk: The terms describe monthly and annual subscriptions, a free version and a 14-day free trial.

item.title: Pixasocial Review (2026): AI Social Content and Posting Suite
item.description: Pixasocial sells one suite in four sizes. The pricing is in flux: the plans, names and amounts had changed between our reads in October and November 2026.

item.title: VideoUpload Review (2026): YouTube Team Board From $20/mo
item.description: VideoUpload charges one flat price per workspace, with no per-seat fees. AI writing uses credits that reset monthly; extra credits are a paid top-up.

item.title: Ploy Review (2026): AI Website Builder, Free to $300/mo
item.description: Ploy: The Free tier costs $0, needs no card and includes 2,000 credits (the plan card says 500 credits a day, up to 2,000).

item.title: Teachable Review (2026): Plans From $39/mo, 7.5% Fee on Starter
item.description: Teachable: Builder is $89 a month, or $69 billed annually. Starter takes 7.5% of every sale on top of the $39 plan.

item.title: PrintSage Review (2026): US Print on Demand, No Subscription
item.description: PrintSage has no subscription and no plan price. Production and shipping are US-only: six US fulfillment centers, no overseas production.

item.title: Compass Review (2026): Meta Ads ROAS for Shopify, $49 a Month
item.description: Compass: $49 a month, or $490 a year. The privacy policy names OpenAI among the services that receive your inputs.

item.title: Lensmor Review (2026): Trade-Show Leads on Credits, From $499
item.description: Lensmor: 10,000 for $249, 25,000 for $549 or 60,000 for $1,199, valid for 12 months. The entry price is high: $499 a month for Basic.

item.title: EditEngine Review (2026): Shopify Bulk Editor, Free to $49.99
item.description: EditEngine has a free plan and three paid plans, and every plan allows unlimited bulk edit, import and export tasks. Undo covers supported in-app edits only.

item.title: Visibility Mesh Review (2026): Shopify AI Search Audits, From $29
item.description: Visibility Mesh: Three plans, billed in USD through Shopify every 30 days, each with a 7-day free trial that includes one full scan.
